text: Bug #1 (middleware/proxy.go) is fixed and verified: with an empty balancer (NewRandomBalancer(nil) / NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)) the proxy no longer panics with index-out-of-range/divide-by-zero; both balancers return nil and the middleware now responds 503 Service Unavailable (echo.ErrServiceUnavailable). go build/vet and the full middleware test suite pass.
Working on it: investigating router.go for the defect behind TestRouterNoRoutablePath. ETA ~8 min.

Working on it: context.go Scheme() currently returns any non-empty X-Forwarded-Proto/Protocol/X-Url-Scheme value verbatim (so an invalid value like "invalid" is returned instead of being ignored), contradicting the documented contract that Scheme returns `http` or `https`. Fix in progress, ETA ~8 min.
Working on it: bind.go map binding (map[string][]string) fix in progress. ETA ~8 min.
Working on it: group.go middleware-slice aliasing bug fix in progress. ETA ~8 min.
Still in progress: router.go fix (TestRouterNoRoutablePath) — root-cause hunt with a fuzz harness is running; ~5 min.

Bug #3 (context.go) is fixed and verified: Scheme() now only accepts forwarded header values that are a valid scheme ("http"/"https") and otherwise ignores them, falling through to the next header and finally to "http". So an invalid X-Forwarded-Proto no longer leaks through (X-Forwarded-Protocol is used instead) and all-invalid forwarded headers fall back to "http". gofmt/build clean, full test suite still passes.
Still in progress: bind.go map binding (map[string][]string) — fix + verification running; ~5 min.
Still in progress: group.go middleware aliasing fix — verification running; ~5 min.
Working on it: middleware/compress.go empty-body (TestGzipEmpty) fix in progress; ~5 min.
